tasks.label: CALM: Check Current File
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && repo_name="${STACK_FITNESS_FUNCTIONS_REPO_NAME:-}"; if [ -z "$repo_name" ]; then common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir); case "$common_dir" in /*) ;; *) common_dir="${workspaceFolder}/$common_dir" ;; esac; repo_name=$(basename "$(dirname "$common_dir")"); fi; mkdir -p .calm && stack-fitness-functions client validate --file "${relativeFile}" --repo "$repo_name" --git-dir "${workspaceFolder}" --format sarif > .calm/results.sarif

tasks.label: CALM: Watch (run on save)
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && repo_name="${STACK_FITNESS_FUNCTIONS_REPO_NAME:-}"; if [ -z "$repo_name" ]; then common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir); case "$common_dir" in /*) ;; *) common_dir="${workspaceFolder}/$common_dir" ;; esac; repo_name=$(basename "$(dirname "$common_dir")"); fi; while true; do inotifywait -e close_write "${file}" 2>/dev/null || fswatch -1 "${file}" 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .calm && stack-fitness-functions client validate --file "${relativeFile}" --repo "$repo_name" --git-dir "${workspaceFolder}" --format sarif > .calm/results.sarif; done
